title: Chewbacca
subtitle: Relentless Rebel
text: Action [2 resources, Exhaust]: Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted. It can't attack bases for this attack.
deployBox: Action: Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted. It can't attack bases for this attack. Use this ability only once each round.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
If you use Chewbacca’s ability, you must attack with a unit, if able.
Chewbacca's action ability cannot be used as an action if you can't attack with a unit, as it would not change the game state.
Units that can’t attack bases can still damage bases through other abilities, like Overwhelm.
